question_set.question: Use color_flows with color equal to value, nodes equal to Payment to characterize the distribution of traffic flowing to payment in order to know what is the distribution of traffic flowing to payment?

answer.value: Fresh Supermarket (Offline Scan/Delivery) is the dominant contributor to Fresh Food business with 4200 GMV, representing 78.1% of all Fresh Food inflows and showing the strongest channel-to-business alignment

key_insights: Fresh Supermarket contributes 78.1% of Fresh Food inflows
Community Group contributes 58.0% of its own flow to Fresh Food
Live Streaming also contributes to Fresh Food but with smaller share
